articles.title: The SEC delayed tokenizing stocks, and here’s why that’s a relief
articles.snippet: Before we rush to tokenize U.S. equities, we need compliance systems that understand context, not just checkboxes. Investors like Michael Burry see the danger, so should the rest of us, urges Chamarajnagar.

articles.title: Strategy's STRC slump prompts Terra comparisons that don't hold up, says analyst
articles.snippet: Benchmark's Mark Palmer says the comparison misreads what STRC is — a dividend-paying share backed indirectly by bitcoin, not a peg waiting to break.

articles.title: Ripple targets EU, wins preliminary MiCA approval from Luxembourg financial regulator
articles.snippet: The license will enable Ripple to offer its stablecoin payment systems to European companies and expand into broader crypto functions.

articles.title: SpaceX’s $600 billion plunge erased equivalent of nearly half of bitcoin’s market cap in 3 days
articles.snippet: The newly public company shed close to half of bitcoin's entire market value in three sessions after announcing its first bond sale. Bitcoin, absorbing the same backdrop, fell less than 1%.

articles.title: Quantum computing is often seen as a risk to bitcoin. Now Trump wants to develop it.
articles.snippet: The White House issued twin executive orders to accelerate U.S. development of large-scale quantum computers while simultaneously hardening defenses against such machines.
